title: prisma migrate dev on a managed database fails with 'permission denied to create database'
symptoms: A migration failed when applied to the shadow database
Database error: Error querying the database: db error: ERROR: permission denied to create database
cause: migrate dev creates and drops a temporary shadow database to replay migrations, which needs CREATEDB or superuser on PostgreSQL. Many hosted databases do not grant it.
fix: Create a separate empty database for the shadow and point shadowDatabaseUrl at it, never at the main database. In Prisma 7 the setting lives in prisma.config.ts.
affected: prisma migrate dev on PostgreSQL roles without CREATEDB; config location changed in Prisma 7.0
